text: {"name":"bt_dev_update","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Updates Bluetooth device/connection timer and state bookkeeping for a device-table entry, processing an update event and decrementing its countdown before returning the affected device entry.","subsystem":"bt","var_renames":{"v1":"bt_dev_table","v2":"dev_index","v3":"update_state","v4":"bt_dev_entry","v7":"bt_dev_entry","v21":"conn_index","v6":"bt_conn_entry","v8":"tick_time","v17":"countdown","v14":"timestamp_prev","v15":"timestamp_curr","v19":"timer64"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":12,"meaning":"base timestamp for connected-state timing"},{"offset":16,"meaning":"update event/state selector"},{"offset":17,"meaning":"device-table index"},{"offset":18,"meaning":"connection state index passed to bt_conn_get_state"},{"offset":19,"meaning":"update countdown or retry limit"},{"offset":24,"meaning":"previous timestamp used for elapsed-time delta"},{"offset":28,"meaning":"current timestamp used for elapsed-time delta"},{"offset":36,"meaning":"64-bit timer or counter state"},{"offset":44,"meaning":"alternative base timestamp when device connection flag is not set"},{"offset":112,"meaning":"bt_dev_entry offset for connection/state flag"},{"offset":113,"meaning":"bt_dev_entry offset for connection-table index"},{"offset":132,"meaning":"bt_dev_entry offset for pending/event flag"}]}
